threads.body: This environment currently exports both AutoGen's built-in telemetry and OpenInference telemetry: the committed report contains the same native `create_agent`/`invoke_agent`/`execute_tool` span classes as `native/data.json` alongside OpenInference spans. Because `data.json` unions attributes by class, this can incorrectly credit OpenInference with native coverage and violates the one-instrumentation rule in `scenarios/gen-ai/AGENTS.md:36-38`. Set `AUTOGEN_DISABLE_RUNTIME_TRACING: "true"` here (supported by AutoGen 0.7.5), then regenerate this implementation's `data.json`.

threads.body: This dependency does not provide the `otel-conformance-python` executable invoked by `conformance.yaml`; that console script comes from the separate `tools/python` project. As written, the native scenarios fail before running. Depend on `otel-conformance-python` and map it to `tools/python`, matching the working native setup in `litellm/native`.

@@ -0,0 +1,21 @@
+[project]
+name = "autogen-native-conformance"
+version = "0.0.0"
+requires-python = ">=3.12"
+dependencies = [
+    "autogen-agentchat==0.7.5",
+    "autogen-ext[openai]==0.7.5",
+    "opentelemetry-api==1.44.0",
+    "opentelemetry-sdk==1.44.0",
+    "opentelemetry-exporter-otlp-proto-grpc==1.44.0",
+    # `otel-conformance-python` installs the SDK providers and loads no
+    # instrumentation, which is what leaves the library's own telemetry the
+    # only thing measured.
+    "opentelemetry-conformance[python]",
+]
+
+[tool.uv.sources]
+opentelemetry-conformance = { path = "../../../../../tools/runner", editable = true }

threads.body:
AutoGen defaults `reflect_on_tool_use` to false, so this run stops after executing the tool and never sends its result in the contract's second model request. Regenerate both reports after this change.
```suggestion
agent = AssistantAgent(
    name="weather_assistant",
    model_client=OpenAIChatCompletionClient(
        model="gpt-4o-mini", max_tokens=100, temperature=0.5
    ),
    system_message="You are a helpful assistant.",
    tools=[get_current_weather],
    reflect_on_tool_use=True,
)
```

+# Copyright The OpenTelemetry Authors
+# SPDX-License-Identifier: Apache-2.0
+
+"""Conformance scenario: an AutoGen agent run that calls a tool.
+
+The tool actually runs, which is the point: an agent framework executes the
+call itself rather than handing it back, so the tool execution is a span of
+its own and not just a message in the next request.
+"""
+
+import asyncio
+
+from autogen_agentchat.agents import AssistantAgent
+from autogen_ext.models.openai import OpenAIChatCompletionClient
+
+
+def get_current_weather(location: str) -> str:
+    """Get the current weather in a given location."""
+    return f"70 degrees and sunny in {location}"
+
+
+agent = AssistantAgent(
+    name="weather_assistant",
+    model_client=OpenAIChatCompletionClient(
+        model="gpt-4o-mini", max_tokens=100, temperature=0.5
+    ),
+    system_message="You are a helpful assistant.",
+    tools=[get_current_weather],
+)
